_comment: Scenario battery for Ryde Health's Node 3 (claude-haiku-4-5, Override: Disabled). Created 2026-09-02 -- same structural fix as intuitive_health_and_wellness (see that clinic's scenarios file): location_id_map switched from '' (fully dynamic) to a static single entry 'Ryde Natural Health'=5, matching node_2_service_resolution.txt's existing LOCATION_RULE ('This clinic has ONE location. NEVER ask the caller about location.'). Confirmed via DB (businesses table): this clinic (clinic_name 'Ryde Natural Health Clinic', clinic_id cb42bc45-753e-4f49-87aa-f39251de8ec4) has exactly ONE business row, and all 24 agent_practitioner_schedules practitioners have rows only there. NOTE: this clinic is currently NOT LIVE (clinics.active=false, no entry in clinic_agent_ids.json) -- this scenario file documents the fix for when the clinic is (re)onboarded; it has not been run against a live/patched agent. See scripts/generate_node3.py CLINIC_CONFIGS['ryde_health'] and .claude/rules/node-edit-verification.md.

scenarios.name: acupuncture-anna-no-location-ask

history.content: I'd like to book Acupuncture with Anna please, I've been before.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does NOT ask which location the caller wants (no 'which location works for you' question anywhere), silently resolves confirmed_location, and either asks the TIMEFRAME QUESTION ('When would you like to come in?') or proceeds toward checking availability. FAIL if the agent asks the caller to choose a location in any form.

scenarios.name: physiotherapy-anyone-no-location-ask

history.content: Can I get Physiotherapy booked in, anyone is fine, sometime tomorrow afternoon.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does NOT ask about location at any point and proceeds toward checking availability for tomorrow afternoon (e.g. 'Checking that now, one moment.' + a tool call). FAIL if the agent asks a location question or defers progress waiting on a location answer.
